tips.why: Appalachian State and St. Bonaventure boast impressive defensive numbers, but their identical 4-1 records conceal a substantial strength-of-schedule discrepancy. The Mountaineers have faced considerably tougher opposition. App State's loss came at Auburn while the Bonnies lost at home to Youngstown State. Despite concerns surrounding Appalachian State's elevated luck rating, catching 4.5 points offers value with the Mountaineers.
tips.author: Napier Montgomery

tips.why: Ole Miss is expected to finish near the bottom of the SEC. They are 4-0 so far, but against soft competition. Clemson has had sustained success, and their shooting and offensive efficiency should carry them. They could win outright, but I'll take the points.
tips.author: Chad Hartsock

tips.why: In games in which Brentford haven't had a man sent off, the London side has allowed just one goal in four opportunities. Led by Kristoff Ajer and Caoimhin Kelleher, the Bees' defense possesses one of the strongest defenses in the league.
tips.author: Estevão Maximo

tips.why: BYU lost 2 players to the first round of the NBA draft, but they still appear to have enough firepower to be one of the best offenses in the country again this year. Washington has some shooters, but probably not enough to keep up with the numbers BYU tends to put up.
tips.author: Chad Hartsock

tips.why: Charlotte has won once in ten games, while Memphis recently saw its perfect 8-0 road record end at the hands of Minnesota. Heading into that affair, the Grizzlies also fostered five consecutive wins and covers. Despite the enormous disparity in form, the Grizzlies are laying a short number. This smells of an upset.
tips.author: Napier Montgomery

tips.why: Philadelphia has exceeded 130 points in three of its last four games while allowing 123 or more in those recent contests against nominal opposition. Portland averages approximately 116 points. With both offenses capable of reaching mid 110 figures, backing the Over to hit 232 to get a push even is a value proposition.
tips.author: Napier Montgomery

tips.why: The Mammoth are getting healthier, and the offense continues to heat up. Utah's power play percentage of 32.5% ranks 3rd in the league, and they are playing with plenty of confidence after back-to-back wins over the Ducks and Avalanche.
tips.author: Connor Grootenhuis

tips.why: Taking into account LAFC's 17 away matches in the regular season, only the Seattle Sounders have been involved in games with fewer goals—LAFC has scored 20 and allowed 22. Meanwhile, St. Louis City is coming off back-to-back 1-0 results: a win and a loss.
tips.author: Estevão Maximo

tips.why: Daniels is the x-factor here. The Bengals’ defense has improved overall, but the former LSU standout will be at his best against a good-not-great resistance. The other former LSU star, Joe Burrow, is the leading candidate for this season’s MVP and is unlikely to slow down in any regard, either. A 31-27 scenario is a likely result.
tips.author: Chris Farley

tips.why: It’s important to note that this spot is significantly better for the home team, coming off 10 days of rest and with a ton of motivation to hang around in a close NFC East race. The Bengals have looked great, but they’re also coming off a game in Madrid followed by a huge win against their rival last Sunday night.
tips.author: Chris Farley

tips.why: Providence holds a significant defensive advantage over VCU, ranking 14th nationally in points allowed and 16th in defensive rebounding. Those numbers have been established against credible opposition, including Nebraska and Colorado. In a neutral-site matchup requiring only a two-point victory, the Friars' superior defense should prove decisive.
tips.author: Napier Montgomery

tips.why: San Antonio is 14-3 and has won 14 of its last 15, while Sacramento is 2-14 despite recently upsetting Boston. The Spurs' championship contender credentials and the Kings' prolonged struggles create an enormous perceived mismatch. That disparity inflates the spread, making Sacramento the value play, as no matter what, we are getting them at an enhanced number.
tips.author: Napier Montgomery

tips.why: Galatasaray's only home loss this season came against La Liga leader Barcelona. Facing an Aston Villa squad that hasn't won a game in a month, the Turkish side should feel confident about their chances in this exciting matchup.
tips.author: Estevão Maximo

tips.why: Houston Dynamo's offensive woes showed up in both encounters against the San Jose Earthquakes during the regular season; Ben Olsen's side was held scoreless in a win and a draw against the Californian side.
tips.author: Estevão Maximo
